svg.title: NEXORA FPT - corporate website, private repository
svg.desc: NEXORA FPT, case study 02. Private repository, not linked. Corporate marketing website for NEXORA FPT, an AI and software company in Hanoi founded in 2026. One page, English and Vietnamese, statically generated. Accessibility-minded with a skip link and reduced-motion support. Artwork: a Signal Lattice network of nodes and edges, the visual idea of the site. Lighthouse mobile: Performance 95 to 97, Accessibility 100, Best Practices 100, SEO 100. Stack: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion.
